advanced-filter-description: Aswan suysuyqa kay ruraqkunayuq qillqata qillqanaykipaq saqisunki: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ruraqkuna chawpipiqa ch'usaq k'itiwan t'aqakun. Llapa kikin ruwasqa chaqrakunata suysuyta atinki sutinkunata chaninkunatapas qillqaspa. Kay hina: Field1 == Value1. Yuyariy: chaqrakuna utaq chanikuna ch'usaq k'itiyuq kaptinqa, huk ch'ullalla comillaskunapi wichqanayki tiyan. Kay hina: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ch'ulla kamachiq sanampakunata (' \/) p'itanaykipaq, \. nisqata servichikuy atinki. Kay hina: Field1 == I\'m. Hinallataq achka kamachiykunata huñuyta atinki. Kay hina: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Sapa kutillam llapa ruraqkuna lluq'imanta paññaman ñawinchakun. Siqichayta tikrayta atinki wichqanakunata churaspa. Kay hina: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Hinallataq qillqa chaqrakunata regexwan maskhayta atinki: F1 == /Tes.*/i

Aswan hanaq patapi kaq t'aqakuna sutisuyuman tukunku, chaykunap uranpi kaq churin t'aqakuna kartaman tukunku, t'aqap qillqasqanta kartap willakuyninpaq churaspa. Aswan ukhupi kaq t'aqakuna qhawana sutisuyuman tukunku. Unanchasqa t'aqakuna tukusqa hina apamukun.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Huk todo.txt willañiqita k'askachiy: sapa wachupi huk llamk'ana, todo.txt programawan paywan tinkuq programakuna qillqasqankuman hina. Tukusqa llamk'anakuna ("x") Tukusqaman rinku, +project hinaspa @context sutichanakunaman tukunku, (A) ñawpaqman churana sutichanaman tukun, due: hinaspa t: tukuynin p'unchawman hinaspa qallariynin p'unchawman tukunku.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export kamachiyta ruraspa lluqsiqta k'askachiy: JSON siqi, utaq sapa wachupi huk rurana. Tukusqa ruranakuna Done sutisuyuman rinku, project hinallataq priority unanchakuna tukunku, annotations rimaykuna tukun, depends hark'aq ruranakunamanta hapipakuyman tukun.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: .boardarchive kiputa kichay, hinaspa pirqap board.jsonl kaqninta k'askachiy, musuqchasqa yupaypa wachunwan utaq mana chay wachuyuq. Pirqa qhawaypa huñunapaq kaynin sutisuyukuna tukun, huk akllana kayninkuna unanchakuna tukunku, qillqa hinallataq chimpuna tawa kuchu t'aqakuna willakuywan qhawana sutisuyu tukunku, rimaykunataqa waqaychanku. Wankikuna hinallataq yapasqakunaqa manam apamusqachu kanku.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-planka: Planka nisqaykiq tiyananta qillqay (kayhina https://planka.example.com), Planka llamkaqpa sutinta pakasqa rimaytawan, chaymanta «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» nisqata ñit'iy. Tablata apamunallapaqmi llamk'achikun, manataq waqaychakunchu. Huk tablata akllay «Apamuy» nisqatataq ñit'iy: WeKan Planka API nisqamanta sutisuyunkunawan, kartankunawan, willakuyninkunawan, tukukuy p'unchawninkunawan, unanchankunawan, ayllumasinkunawan, llamk'ay sutisuyunkunawan rimayninkunawan ima ñawirin, chaymanta yaykuchiyta hinallataq qatiy. Planka waqaychanapi kaq kartakunaqa waqaychasqa hina yaykuchikun; t'inkisqakuna, q'upa churanapi kaq kartakunapas manam yaykuchikunchu.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Microsoft Graph Explorer nisqapi (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) yaykuy, Tasks.Read saqiyta munay, Access token nisqamanta token nisqata copiay. Kaypi k'askachiy «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» nisqatataq ñit'iy; token kay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu. Tukuy sutisuyukunata utaq hukta akllay «Apamuy» nisqatataq ñit'iy. Sapa To Do sutisuyu sutisuyuman tukun, sapa llamk'aytaq kartaman, willakuyninkunawan, tukukuy qallariy p'unchawninkunawan, puriyninkuna qhawana sutisuyu hina, t'aqakuna unancha hina, hatun chaniyuq kaynin kayninpas unancha hina; tukusqa llamk'aykuna waqaychakun. Yuyarichiykuna kutipaykunapas manam yaykuchikunchu.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: KanbanFlow nisqapi tablaq menunta kichay, Settings → API & Webhooks nisqata akllay, tablaq API token nisqanta copiay. Tokenta kaypi k'askachiy, «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» nisqata ñit'iy, tablata akllay «Apamuy» nisqatataq ñit'iy; token chay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu. Sayaqkuna sutisuyuman tukun, ñankunataq ñanllapuni qhepan; llamk'aykuna willakuyninta, llimp'inta, unanchankunata, tukukuy p'unchawninta, uchuy llamk'aykunata qhawana sutisuyu hina, pacha llamk'achisqata, yupaykunata, runakunata rimaykunatapas waqaychan.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Basecamp yupaykiq ID nisqanta qillqay (tiyanapi basecamp.com/ qhepanpi yupay) huk yaykuy token nisqatapas (launchpad.37signals.com nisqapi qillqachisqa OAuth 2 appmanta, utaq ña kaq huñunakuyta kapuqmanta), «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» nisqata ñit'iy, huk ruranata akllay «Apamuy» nisqatataq ñit'iy. Token chay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu. Sapa karta tabla ñanman tukun sayaqninkunawan sutisuyu hina, ruranakuna sutisuyukunataq «To-dos» ñanman tukun; kartakuna ruranakunapas qillqanta, p'unchawninkunata, churasqa runakunata rimayninkunatapas waqaychan, kartaq puriyninkuna qhawana sutisuyuman tukun, tukusqa ruranakunataq waqaychakun.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: OAuth 2.0 Playground nisqamanta yaykuy token nisqata hap'iy: Tasks API v1 ukhupi tasks.readonly akllay, Authorize APIs ñit'iy, chaymanta Exchange authorization code for tokens, yaykuy tokentataq copiay. Kaypi k'askachiy «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» nisqatataq ñit'iy, tukuy llamk'ay sutisuyukunata utaq hukta akllay, chaymanta «Apamuy». Token kay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu. Llamk'ay sutisuyukuna sutisuyuman tukun, llamk'aykunataq kartaman, willakuyninkunawan, t'inkinkunawan tukukuy p'unchawninwan; uchuy llamk'aykuna qhawana sutisuyuman tukun, tukusqa llamk'aykunataq waqaychasqa hina yaykuchikun.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep API nisqaqa Google Workspace yupaykunallapaqmi. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly chiqayuq OAuth 2.0 yaykuy token nisqata hap'iy (OAuth 2.0 Playground nisqapi Workspace kamachiqniyki saqiptinqa, utaq tukuy dominio kamachiyniyuq serviciu yupaymanta), k'askachiy, «Yaykuchiy atikuqkunata rikuchiy» chaymanta «Apamuy» ñit'iy. Token kay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu. Qillqa willakuykuna «Notes» sutisuyupi kartaman tukun, qhawana sutisuyu willakuykunataq «Lists» sutisuyupi kartaman tukun imankunawan qhawana sutisuyu hina. Q'upapi willakuykuna, t'inkisqakuna, rakinakuypas manam yaykuchikunchu.
api-import-desc: Kikiyki yupaywan serviciumanta apamuy. Kaypi qillqasqaykiqa kay apamuyllapaqmi, manataq waqaychakunchu.
api-import-nothing: Kay yupaywanqa manam imapas yaykuchinapaq kanchu.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.
import-board-instruction-trello: Trello pirqaykipi, 'Menu' nisqaman riy, chaymanta 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', lluqsimuq qillqatataq qillqapay.
import-board-instruction-csv: Comawan t'aqasqa chanikunata (CSV)/ Tabwan t'aqasqa chanikunata (TSV) kaypi ch'aqchuy .
import-board-instruction-jira: Jira Cloud sasachakuy maskhaypa JSONninta ch'aqchuy: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (fields mana kaptinqa sasachakuy idkunallatam kutichin). Hatun proyectoqa p'anqakunapi hamun, sapankataq hamuqpaq nextPageToken nisqayuq: llapa p'anqakunapa sasachakuyninkunata huk "issues" huñuman churay, utaq sapa p'anqata kikin pirqa hina apamuy Achka pirqakunata apamuywan. Kikin hina { "issues": [...] } objetopas llamkanmi. Jira kayninkuna sutisuyukunaman tikrakun, sasachakuykunataq kartakunaman. Munaspaqa "automationRules" huñutapas churay kamachikunata apamunaykipaq.
import-board-instruction-excel: Huk .xlsx qillqa mayt'uta akllay: sapa siqipi huk kartayuq tawla (Suti, Willakuy, Kay/Sutisuyu, Ayllumasikuna, Unanchakuna, p'unchawkuna, kikin ruwasqa chaqrakuna hina columnakuna), utaq WeKan hurqusqan qillqa mayt'u, sapa pirqa kikin p'anqanpi kaqpas. Qatiq ruraypi rikuchikun mayqin columnachus mayqin chaqra kasqanta. Uma siqiyuq sapa p'anqa pirqaman tikrakun.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Pirqaykipi, 'Menu' nisqaman riy, chaymanta 'Export board', uraykachisqa willayqillqapi qillqatataq qillqapay.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Pirqata apamuspa pantaykuna rikhuriptinqa, wakin kutipi apamuyqa llamkallantaq, pirqataq Llapa pirqakuna p'anqapi kachkan.
import-members-mode-map: Choose an existing user for each of them
import-members-mode-placeholder: Keep them as placeholder users with their own names, to map to real users later
csv-mapping-description: Choose the column of the file that holds each card field. The choices were made from the column names; change any that are wrong, and choose (not in the file) for a field the file does not have.
csv-mapping-list-missing: The file has no column for the list. Choose one above, or type the name of the one list every card goes into.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Other columns to import as text custom fields:
csv-mapping-boards: Each sheet becomes its own board:
csv-mapping-title-required: Choose the column that holds the card titles.
csv-mapping-list-required: Type the name of the list every card goes into, or choose the column that holds the list.
invalid-import-mapping: The column mapping does not match the file.
import-many-boards-hint: Choose several export files of this tool, or one .zip that holds them: each file becomes its own board, imported without member mapping. A .zip that is itself one export (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, or WeKan with attachments) is one board. When files are chosen here, Import imports them instead of the field above.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Each swimlane the import would make (a project, folder or list of the tool) becomes its own board. Parent cards and dependencies between those boards are listed in the import report.
export-all-boards-hint: Every board you can export, in one download: Excel as one workbook with a sheet per board named after it, every other format as a .zip with a file per board.
import-attachments-zip: Trello watasqakuna ZIP (munaspa, Trello Card Attachments Downloader nisqamanta)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Huk Trello pirqa .json hina hurqusqa. Trello API key tokentapas waqaychasqa kaptiykiqa, watasqankuna, pirqapa qhipa siq'in, ayllumasikunapa rikch'ayninkunapas uraykachikullantaq.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Huk utaq aswan pirqa .json willayqillqakunayuq .zip, watasqankunataq pirqa-suti uchuy q'ipikunapi (Trello Card Attachments Downloader nisqamanta). Llapa pirqakuna apamusqa kanqa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: .zip ukhupi manam Trello pirqa .json willayqillqakuna tarikurqachu.
import-trello-zip-progress: .zipmanta pirqakunata apamuchkan, ama hina kaspa suyay…
import-timeout: Apamuyqa ancha unaytam karqa, sayachisqataq karqa. Ama hina kaspa wakmanta ruray; kaqllata pasachkaptinqa, pirqa ancha hatun kanman utaq willakuy huñuqa ruraywan hunt'a kanman.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: .zip ukhupi huk willayqillqa apamunapaq ancha hatunmi.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: .zipqa mana hark'asqa willayqillqa ñankunayuqmi, mana chaskisqataq karqa.
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Apamusqa pirqaqa kay llamkana pacha ukhupi churakun, mana kaptinqa ruwakun
import-trello-parent-workspace: Apamusqa llamkana pachakunata kay ukhupi churay
trello-api-import: Trellomanta API key tokenwan chiqalla apamuy
trello-api-import-desc: Trello API key tokenta ch'aqchuy Trello llamkana pachaykikunata pirqaykikunatapas sutisuyupi rikunaykipaq, chaymanta akllasqakunata watasqankunawan apamuy.
trello-api-token: Trello API token (API key uraypi makiwan ruwasqa)
trello-api-credentials-required: Ama hina kaspa, Trello API key tokentapas iskayninta qillqay.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Trello API key tokenpas waqaychasqa. Llamkana pachakunata wakmanta mana qillqaspa sutisuyupi rikuchiyta atinki.
trello-export-desc: Create a copy of this board in Trello through Trello's API, with your Trello API key and token. Swimlanes become labels named "Swimlane: …", which WeKan's Trello import turns back into swimlanes.
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: A Sandstorm grain has no Internet access of its own. Allow this grain to reach Trello first.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, for importing and exporting boards
trello-select-boards: Ama hina kaspa, apamunapaq huk pirqatapas akllay.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: ¿Apamuyta saqispa kay llamkaywan ña apamusqa pirqakunata pichanki? Kayqa manam kutichiyta atikunchu.
import-members-map: Apamusqa pirqaykiqa wakin ayllumasiyuqmi. Ama hina kaspa, apamuyta munasqayki ayllumasikunata runaykikunaman tupachiy
import-members-map-note: Yuyariy: Mana tupachisqa ayllumasikunaqa kunan runaman churasqa kanqa.
import-user-select: Kay ayllumasi hina servichikunaykipaq kaq runaykita akllay
invalid-year: Mana allin wata. Ama hina kaspa llapa tawa yupaykunata qillqay, kay hina: 2026.
shared-labels-desc: Kaypi waqaychasqa unanchakunataqa achka pirqakunapim llamk'achiyta atikun, sapa pirqaq kikin unanchankunawan kuska. Kaypi hukpa sutinta utaq llimp'inta tikraspaqa, llamk'achiq llapa pirqakunapim tikrakun; hukta pichaspaqa, chay pirqakunapim kikinkuq unanchanta hina qhepakun.
label-delete-pop: Manam kutichiyta atikunchu. Kayqa kay unanchata llapa kartakunamanta qichunqa, willakuy kawsayninta chinkachinqa.
last-admin-desc: Manam ruwaykunata tikrayta atinkichu, huk kamachiqpas kananmi tiyan.
hide-board: Kay pirqata saqiy: Llapa pirqakunamanta pakay. Huñuykipi utaq tantanakuypi ayllumasi kayniyki qipan, Ayllumasi allichaykuna / Pakasqa pirqakuna kutichimun.
group-members-read-only: Kay huñupa kamachiqninkunallam pikunachus ukhupi kasqanta tikrayta atinku. LDAP-manta utaq huk sutisuyumanta hamuq huñuqa chaypim tikrakun, manam WeKan-pichu.
leave-board-pop: ¿Chiqaqtachu __boardTitle__ saqiyta munanki? Kay pirqapi llapa kartakunamanta qichusqa kanki.
list-archive-cards: Kay sutisuyupi llapa kartakunata waqaychanaman apay
list-archive-cards-pop: Kayqa kay sutisuyupi llapa kartakunata pirqamanta qichunqa. Waqaychanapi kartakunata rikunaykipaq pirqaman kutichinaykipaqpas, “Menu” > “Waqaychana” ñit'iy.
list-delete-pop: Llapa ruraykuna ruray willakuymanta qichusqa kanqa, sutisuyutataq manam kutichiyta atinkichu. Manam kutichiyta atikunchu.
list-delete-suggest-archive: Sutisuyuta waqaychanaman apayta atinki pirqamanta qichunaykipaq, ruraykunatataq waqaychanaykipaq.
log-out-everywhere-confirm: Kayqa tukuy maskana, telefono, app-kunamanta ima lluqsichisunki, maypichus yaykusqa kanki, kaytapas.
passkeys-description: Yaykuna llaveqa pakasqa rimayniykiq rantinpi kay antanpa ruk'ana unanchawan, uyawan, pantalla wichqanawan utaq waqaychana llavewan yaykunaykipaq. Antaykipim qipan; WeKan-qa llaqtapa llaventa sapallanta waqaychan.
passkeys-unsupported: Kay maskanaqa manam yaykuna llavesta ruwayta atinchu.
passkey-invalid: Manam chay yaykuna llaveta llamk'achiyta atikurqanchu.
passkey-sign-in-failed: Yaykuna llavewan yaykuyqa manam allintachu llamk'arqan. Hukmanta ruway, utaq huk ñanwan yaykuy.
passkey-too-many: Huk cuentaq kapuyta atinan aswan achka yaykuna llavesmi kapusunki. Ñawpaqta hukta qichuy.
passkey-needs-https: Yaykuna llavesqa WeKan-ta huk https:// tiyanapi munanku.
muted-info: Kay pirqapi ima tikraymantapas manam hayk'appas willasqa kankichu
name: Suti
normal-desc: Kartakunata qhawayta allichaytapas atin. Allichaykunata mana tikrayta atinchu.
normal-assigned-only-desc: Churasqa kartakunalla rikukun. Sapa kaq runa hina allichan.
notify-participate: Ruwaq utaq ayllumasi hina kasqayki kartakunamanta musuqchaykunata chaskiy
notify-watch: Qhawapasqayki pirqakunamanta, sutisuyukunamanta, kartakunamantapas musuqchaykunata chaskiy
page-maybe-private: Kay p'anqaqa pakasqa kanman. Yaykuspa rikuyta atiwaqmi.
paste-or-dragdrop: ch'aqchunaykipaq, utaq siq'i willayqillqata kayman aysaspa churay (siq'illa)
private-desc: Kay pirqaqa pakasqam. Pirqaman yapasqa runakunallam qhawayta allichaytapas atinku.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

Chanipi ch'usaq kitikuna utaq sapan siq'ikuna kaptinqa, rimay unanchakunapi wichqasqa kanan (kay hina `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - *<name>* huñunakuyman churasqa pirqap kartankuna
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - *<name>* huñuman churasqa pirqap kartankuna
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kunanmanta *<n>* p'unchawkunakama tukuy pachayuq kartakuna. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ tukuy pachanmanta qhipa kaq llapan kartakunata rikuchin.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - *<n>* p'unchawkuna ñawpaqta utaq aswan qayllapi kamasqa kartakuna
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - *<n>* p'unchawkuna ñawpaqta utaq aswan qayllapi tikrasqa kartakuna
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - *<field>*qa kaykunamanta hukninmi: `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` utaq `__predicate_member__`. *<field>*pa ñawpaqninpi `-` churayqa chay kanchapi chani mana kasqanta maskan (kay hina `has:-due` mana tukuy pachayuq kartakunata maskan).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - *<sort-name>*qa kaykunamanta hukninmi: `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` utaq `__predicate_modified__`. Uraman ñiqichanapaqqa, ñiqichay sutip ñawpaqninpi `-` churay.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - *<n>*qa sapa p'anqapi rikuchina kartakunap yupayninta niq aswan ch'usaqmanta hatun hunt'a yupaymi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Kaqlla operadorkunaqa *UTAQ*wan huñusqa kanku. Mayqin kamachiywanpas tupaq kartakunam kutimun.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` *Blocked* utaq *Available* sutiyuq mayqin sutisuyupipas kaq kartakunata kutichimunman.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Hukniray operadorkunaqa *HINALLATAQ*wan huñusqa kanku. Llapan hukniray operadorkunawan tupaq kartakunallam kutimun. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` *Available* sutisuyupi *puka* unanchayuq kartakunallata kutichimun.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: P'unchawkunaqa aswan ch'usaqmanta hatun utaq aswan ch'usaqmanta uchuy hunt'a yupaywan churasqa kanman, utaq kunan pachapaq `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` utaq `__predicate_year__` nisqawan.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Qillqa maskaykunaqa hatun uchuy qillqakunata manam t'aqanchu.

Kaymi rikuchin chay astay allinta rurakusqanta, ñawpaq MongoDB willakuy waqaychana willañiqikuna grain ukhupi hayk'a disko ch'usaq kaqta llamk'achisqankunatapas, ch'usaq kaqta kacharinapaqtaq chay willañiqikunata pichayta atichisunki.

disable-notifications-description: Kawsachisqa kaptin, WeKan-qa manapuni qhaway willaykunata apachinchu (app ukhupi, email-pi utaq huk serviciokunapi) ima ruraypaqpas. Ruraykunaqa qillqasqallam kanman (hanaqpi mana wañuchisqa kaptin); willaykunallam hark'asqa. Ñawpaq kamachisqaqa wañusqam.
disable-watch-description: Kawsachisqa kaptin, qhaway ruraymi wañuchisqa — llamk'achiqkunaqa manam pirqakunaman, sutisuyukunaman utaq kartakunaman willaykunata chaskinankupaq qillqakuyta atinkuchu, qhaway patata tikray munaypas mana chaskisqachu. Ñawpaq kamachisqaqa wañusqam.
backup-description: Kuskachisqa qillqa-wayaqakunata, riqsichikuq siqikunata hinaspa/utaq willaykunata amachana copiapi waqaychay (llapan qillqasqa willay huñukunata, kuskachisqa qillqa-wayaqakuna utaq riqsichikuq siqikuna mana kaqkunata). .zip nisqata akllasqa waqaychanaman chiqallanta apachin; mana pisi pachallapaq qillqa-wayaqata ruranchu. backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip sutiyuqmi waqaychasqa kan, ukhupitaq YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars hinaspa /data kan. Internetpi waqaychanakuna (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) sapa waqaychana rap'ipi kamachisqa yaykuna willaykunata llamkachinku.
backup-scope-description: Llapan instancia, utaq huk Huñunakuylla. Huñunakuypa waqaychasqa kikinchayninqa pirqankunata, chaypi llapa kaqtapas, chay pirqakunapa watasqankunatapas hap'in — ichaqa manam llamk'achiq yupaykunata, manataq instancia allichaykunata, chaykunaqa llapa Huñunakuykunapa rakinakusqanmi. Huñunakuypa waqaychasqa kikinchayninta kutichispaqa chay Huñunakuypa kapuq pirqankunallamanmi qillqan.
continuous-backup-description: Willay pirwapi, kuskachisqa qillqa-wayaqakunapi, riqsichikuq siqikunapi hinaspa llamkay qillqakunapi sapa tikrayta huk waqaychana pataman pisi segundokunallapi apachin, mayqin pachapipas kasqanman kutichinapaq. Pacha kamachisqa copia waqaychaywan kuska llamkan; chaymi hunt'asqa archivokunata ruran.
continuous-backup-enabled: Kay servidorpi mana sayaspa amachana copiata waqaychayta llamkachiy
continuous-backup-target: Waqaychana pata (hunt'asqa ñan, huk discopi, llikapi rakisqa waqaychanapi utaq t'inkisqa rclone waqaychanapi)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Mana mayqin willay pirwapa llamkachiqninpas kay servidorpi llamkayta atinchu
continuous-backup-key-file: Pakasqa sananchaypa llawinpa qillqa-wayaqan (hunt’asqa ñan, waqaychana patapa hawapi; 64 hexadecimal sanancha utaq 16 sananchayuq icha aswan sananchayuq pakasqa rimay). Huk copiata waqaychay: kay qillqa-wayaqa mana kaptinqa, amachana copiata kutichiyta manam atikunmanchu.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite willay pirwapa qillqa-wayaqan (amachana copiapa waqtanpi rurasqa, mana hayk'aqpas llamkachisqa qillqa-wayaqapa hawanpi qillqanchu)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Qatiq wakmanta qallariypi wakmanta rurasqa SQLite willay pirwata churay (ñawpaq willay pirwa rantichasqa waqaychasqa kanqa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Akllasqa copia huñuta akllasqa pachaman kutichiychu? Mana sayaspa copia waqaychayqa kutichiy llamkachkaptin pisi pachata sayanqa.
continuous-backup-saved: Mana sayaspa copia waqaychaypa kamachiykuna waqaychasqa
backup-restore-select-first: Ñawpaqta sutisuyumanta huk waqaychasqa kikinchayta akllay.
backup-restore-confirm: Akllasqa amachana copiata kutichiychu? Kuskachisqa qillqa-wayaqakuna hinaspa riqsichikuq siqikuna qillqa-wayaqa llikaman qillqasqa kanqa, willaykunataq willay pirwaman, akllasqa rurayman hina.
gcs-key-filename-description: Akllanapaq: servidorpi servicio yupaypa JSON kichanan willañiqipa ñannin.
gcs-credentials-description: Akllanapaq: servicio yupaypa JSON kichananta k'askachiy. Kichana willañiqita utaq ñawpaq kamachisqa riqsichiykunata llamk'achinapaq ch'usaqta saqiy.
gcs-permissions-note: WeKan-pa servicio yupayninman p'uyñupi ñawinchanapaq/qillqanapaq yaykuyta quy: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → p'uyñuyki → Permissions → Grant access. "New principals" nisqapi servicio yupaypa email-ninta k'askachiy — JSON kichanaykimanta "client_email" chaninta — chaymanta "Storage Object Admin" ruraqta akllay, Save nisqatataq ñit'iy.
gcs-bucket-description: Willañiqikunata waqaychanapaq Cloud Storage p'uyñupa sutin.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: ch'usaqta saqiy (suyupa tukukuyninta llamk'achin). S3-wan tupaq: MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces consolaykimanta Endpoint URL.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → p'uyñuyki → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → p'uyñuykipa sutin (utaq Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → llamk'achiqniyki → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → 'Application running outside AWS' llamk'ana kaqta akllay → Create access key. 'Access key ID' hina rikukun.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Access key ID kaq pantallallapim; 'Secret access key' nisqaqa kichana kamasqa kaptinlla huk kutillam rikukun — chay pachallapi kikinchay (utaq Download .csv).

azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yupayniyki → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yupayniyki → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yupayniyki → Data storage → Containers → p'uyñuyki (utaq + Container hukta kamanapaq).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → hanaqpi proyecto akllana → proyectoykipa ID-nin (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → p'uyñuykipa sutin (utaq Create hukta kamanapaq).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: WeKan servidorpi uraqachisqa servicio yupaypa JSON kichanan willañiqiman ñan (uraypi kamasqa). Kayta llamk'achiy UTAQ JSON-ta uraypi pampaman k'askachiy.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → servicio yupayniyki → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (willañiqita uraqachin). Ukhunpi kaqninta kaypi k'askachiy, utaq willañiqita waqaychaspa hanaqpi ñanninta churay.
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Watasqakuna avatarkuna rikukunanpaq, CollectionFS-manta ima huk waqaychanamanpas astay.
s3-enabled-description: Willañiqi waqaychanapaq AWS S3 utaq MinIO-ta llamk'achiy
s3-endpoint-description: S3 tukukuypa URL-nin (ahinataq, s3.amazonaws.com utaq minio.example.com)
writable-path-description: Willañiqi waqaychanapaq tiksi qillqa wasipa ñannin
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Pirqa willakuykunapa hunt'a kayninpaq hunt'asqa qhawaykunata allichaykunatapas ruran, sutisuyukunapa ñiqinta, kartakunapa kasqanta, ñankunapa wakichiynintapas.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Iskaychasqa ch'usaq sutisuyukunata mana manchakuspa pichan. Mana kartayuq sutisuyukunallatam qichun, kartayuq kikin uma sutiyuq huk sutisuyu kaptinlla.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: swimlaneId utaq listId mana kaq kartakunata sutisuyukunatapas tarispa kutichin. 'Chinkasqa kartakuna' ñanta kaman llapa chinkasqa kaqkuna wakmanta rikukunanpaq.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Llapa waqaychasqa ñankunata, sutisuyukunata, kartakunatapas kutichin. Mana kaq swimlaneId utaq listId-ta kikinmanta allichan kaqkuna rikukunanpaq.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Pirqapa wakichiyninpi mana kaq utaq waqllisqa sutisuyukunata tarispa allichan.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Pirqa ayllumasikunapa avatar URL-ninkunata musuqyachin allin waqaychanata llamk'achinankupaq, p'akisqa avatar rikuchiykunatapas allichan.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kay pirqapi llapa watasqa willañiqi URL-kunata musuqyachin allin waqaychanata llamk'achinankupaq, p'akisqa willañiqi rikuchiykunatapas allichan.
migrations-description: Kay pirqapaq willakuykunapa hunt'a kayninta qhawaykunata allichaykunatapas purichiy. Sapa astaytam sapallanpi purichiyta atikun.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Kaymi hunt'asqa astayta ruranqa pirqa willakuykunapa hunt'a kayninta qhawanapaq allichanapaqpas. Kayqa as unayta unayanman. ¿Qatinkichu?

run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Kaymi LLAPA waqaychasqa ñankunata, sutisuyukunata, kartakunatapas kutichinqa, wakmanta rikukunankupaq. Mana kaq ID-yuq kaqkunaqa kikinmanta allichasqa kanqa. Kayqa manam facil kutichiyta atikunchu. ¿Qatinkichu?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Kaymi pirqapa wakichiyninpi mana kaq utaq waqllisqa sutisuyukunata tarispa allichanqa. ¿Qatinkichu?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Kaymi pirqa ayllumasikunapa avatar URL-ninkunata musuqyachinqa allin waqaychanata llamk'achinankupaq. ¿Qatinkichu?

converting-board-description: Pirqapa wakichiyninta tikrachkan aswan allin llamk'anapaq. Kayqa as unayta unayanman.

email-recovery-description: Sapa chaskiqpaq huk sinru. Llamk'achiqpa ID-nwan maskay. Willakuykunapa ukhunpi kaqkunata chaymanta chaskiqpa elektroniku chaski kampukunata mana rikuchinchu. Pisi pachapaq sayachiyqa kunan kaq chaymanta hamuq willakuykunata suyaykachin; qatipayqa sinrupi kaq willakuykunata kunan yapamanta apachiyta kallpachakun. Saqiyqa mañakuypa pachankama sinruman churasqa willakuykunata pichan. Apachiy purichkan chayqa, pisi pacha qhipaman yapamanta kallpachakuy. Apachiyta qallarisqa willakuytaqa manam kutichiyta atinkichu, chaymanta chayasqanta mana yachasqa apachiyqa iskay kutipi kanman. Wiñay pantaykuna chaymanta kallpachakuy yupaypa tukukuyninman chayaq willakuykuna qhawapanapaq waqaychasqa qhipakun. Mana allin lluqsiq willakuykunata yapamanta kallpachakuyqa musuq kallpachakuykunata qallarin chaymanta kunan kaq pisi pachapaq sayachiyta waqaychan.

email-recovery-failed: Llamk'aytaqa manam takyachiyta atikurqanchu. Sinruta musuqyachiy hinaspa chay llamk'ayllatataq yapamanta kallpachakuy sichus munakun chayqa.

email-recovery-retry: Mana allin lluqsiq willakuykunata yapamanta kallpachakuy

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.

interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Kay ruwayta mana tukuyta atikurqanchu. Rap'ita musuqmanta kichay hinaspa yapamanta malliy.
saml-login-not-started: Kay SAML yaykuyqa manam kay maskaqpa pestañanpi qallarirqanchu. Ama hina kaspa, wakmanta yaykuy.
history-request-pending-redo: Sirwiqqa qhipa yapamanta ruwasqaykita manaraq takyachinchu.
history-request-hint: Yapamanta malliptiykiqa, kikin mañakuyllatam yapamanta kachachin, chayrayku manam hayk'aqpas iskay ñiqin tikrayta kutichiyta atinchu.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: An undo, redo or restore of Scrum changes stopped on a conflict. Scrum edits on this board are blocked until it is resolved.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ of __total__ changes were written, __pending__ were not, and __conflicted__ were changed by someone else since.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Rolling back puts every changed record back as it was before; it is offered only when nobody else has changed those records since. Keeping the board as it is removes the stopped operation and changes no records. Either way, it is recorded in Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Keep the board as it is
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Keep every record as it is now, including the changes the stopped operation already wrote?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: A board administrator can roll it back or keep the board as it is.
login-setting-env-only: Only the server environment sets these. They are shown here read-only.

email-to-card-webhook: Chaski quqpa yaykuq webhook URL (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark utaq mana llamk'asqa MIME pasachiq)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Mana imapas - pirqa unanchayniyuq chaskikunalla willaypa umanpi
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Kayta willaypa umanpi churay kikiyki hina kay pirqaman chayanaykipaq:
email-to-card-address-private: Pakallapi hap'iy: pipas kayta riqsiq qampa sutiykipi kartakunata yapanman.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Chaski chaskiyqa manam Kamachiqpa panelninpi allichasqachu.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Pirqaq kamachiqnin manam kay pirqapaq chaskita hap'ichinchu.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Ayllumasipa allichayninkunapi pirqa chaskin tiyayniykikunata wañuchirqanki.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grainqa manaraq chaskin tiyayniyuqchu. Rapita musuqmanta cargay.
inbound-account-invalid: IMAP chaski wasiqa allin servidor sutita munan.
feature-views-email-desc: Pirqa chaski wasi hina: elektroniku chaski sutisuyu Chaskisqakuna, sutisuyukuna q'imirikuna, unanchakuna unanchakuna, ayllumasikunataq pirqaq tiyayninmanta chaskikunata qillqanku kutichinkupas.
email-view-not-receiving: Kay pirqa manaraq chaskita chaskinchu. Pirqaq willakuy churanankunapi hap'ichiy → Elektroniku chaski kartaman.
email-view-invalid-address: Huk tiyaykuna mana allin elektroniku chaski tiyaychu.
email-view-too-many: Qhipa urapi nisyu chaskikuna kachasqa. Qhipaman wakmanta ruray.
feature-views-chat-desc: Pirqa rimanakuy llamk'ana hina: llamk'ana tiyaykuna, pirqakuna, ñankuna, sutisuyukuna kartakunapas kanalkunaq sach'an hina, karta chawpipi, rimaykunantaq rimanakuy willakuykuna hina.
chat-view-pick-card: Kanalkunamanta huk kartata akllay kaypi rikunaykipaq.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Kikin kartakuna achka sutiyuq sayaq siq'i huñukunapi - tukusqaman, aswan chaniyuqman, hatun rumiman utaq imamanpas hina - sayaq siq'ikuna chawpipi aysaspa kuyuchisqa.
column-sets-empty: Manaraq sayaq siq'i huñukuna kanchu. Pirqapa kamachiqnin hukta ruranman: sutichay, chaymanta sayaq siq'inkunata yapay.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Pizarra GitHub utaq Gitea sasachakuy qatipaq hina: tarjetakuna sasachakuy hina, etiquetakuna hinallataq hito nisqakuna, rimaykunaqa rimanakuy hina, yapasqakunaqa willañiqi hina, pizarrapa historiannintaq kutichiywan.
vcs-no-issues: Manam ima sasachakuypas kay maskaywan tupanchu.
vcs-no-milestones: Manaraq hitokuna kanchu. Tukukuy p'unchawniyuq etiquetaqa hitom.
vcs-no-list: Kay pizarraqa mana listayuqchu nitaq ñanniyuqchu sasachakuypaq.
card-qr-code-desc: Qhaway kay tarjetata telefonopi utaq tabletapi kichanapaq.
card-qr-code-too-long: Kay tarjetapa t'inkinqa nisyu sunim QR chimpupaq.
vcs-no-wiki: Manaraqmi wiki kanchu. GitHub huñunakuy yaykuchiyqa huk waqaychanapa wikinta kayman apamun.
github-org-import-desc: Huk huñunakuypa utaq ruraqpa sapa waqaychananmi kikin pirqanman tukun, Board View / Version Control nisqapi kichasqa: sasachakuyninkuna rimayninkunawan, unanchankunawan, willañiqinkunawan, lluqsichisqankuna, GitHub Actions llamk'ay purisqankuna Kamachikuna hina, wikinpas.
github-org-import-token-hint: Pakasqa waqaychanakunapaq, aswan hatun API saywapaqpas necesitakun. Yaykuchiy purichkaptinlla llamk'achikun, manataq hayk'appas waqaychakunchu.
github-org-import-actions: GitHub Actions llamk'ay purisqakuna Kamachikuna hina
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Huñunakuypa utaq ruraqpa sutinta, utaq GitHub tiyananta qillqay.
optional-apis-desc: Huk qatipaqkunaq API-ninkunap rikchayninpi REST API-kuna, paykunap aplicacionninkuna, scriptninkunapas kay WeKan-ta qhipa servidorninkuta hina llamk'achinankupaq: imatachus waqaychanku, chayqa WeKan-pi, WeKan pirqakunapi waqaychakun. Sapankanmi wañusqa kachkan kaypi akllakunankama. Mana mayqinpas kikin atiyniyuqchu: huk cliente WeKan API token-wan yaykun, chay runaq WeKan-pi rikuyta, tikrayta atisqallanta rikunman, tikranmanpas. Llapanmi WeKan REST API hap'ichisqa kananta munanku (WITH_API=true). Sapankanpa uranpi kaq tiyay sutiqa, huk cliente servidorninta hina llamk'achisqanmi.
optional-api-trello-desc: Trello-q REST API-npaq qillqasqa aplicacionkuna, scriptkunapas (kayhina Trellinator) WeKan-wan llamk'anku: pirqakuna, sutisuyukuna, kartakuna, unanchakuna, ayllumasikuna, rimaykuna, qhaway sutisuyukunapas. Trello token-qa huk WeKan API token-mi. Huk kartata pichaspaqa WeKan-pi waqaychanaman apakun.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira-q REST API v2-nin clientekuna WeKan-wan llamk'anku: huk proyectoqa huk pirqa (llavinqa pirqaq llavinmi), huk sasachakuyqa huk karta (DEV-7), huk kayninqa huk sutisuyu, huk tikraytaq kartata kuyuchin. Maskayqa mana sasa JQL-ta chaskin: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text, ORDER BY ima. WeKan API token-wan yaykuy, pakasqa simi hina. Huk sasachakuyta pichaspaqa waqaychanaman apakun.
optional-api-github-desc: Sasachakuykunapaq GitHub-pa REST API-nin clientekuna WeKan-wan llamk'anku: huk waqaychana huñuqa huk pirqa, huk sasachakuyqa huk karta, unanchakunawan, hitokunawan (tukukuy p'unchawniyuq unanchakuna), rimaykunawan, kichasqa utaq wichqasqa kaywan ima, Pirqa qhaway / Musuq kaq kamachiy-pi hina. Token-qa huk WeKan API token-mi.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Sasachakuykunapaq Gitea-pa, Forgejo-pa REST API-nin clientekuna WeKan-wan llamk'anku, GitHub-wan tupaq API hinalla: huk waqaychana huñuqa huk pirqa, huk sasachakuytaq huk karta. Token-qa huk WeKan API token-mi.
bots-none: Manaraq botkuna kanchu. Bot nisqaqa kikiykiq servidorniykipi llamk'aq - AI agente, CI llamk'ay, script - kay pirqa kartakunata payman qun.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Lluqsiq Webhook-kunaqa manam WeKanpa kikin llikanpi tiyaq tiyanakunaman chayayta atinkuchu, ama pipas huk pirqap webhook-ninta huk ukhu llamk'ayman qhawachinanpaq. Kaypi qillqay chay llikapi host-kunata, maymanchus webhook-kuna chayayta atinku - huk Node-RED, huk rimanakuy servidor - sapa siq'ipi hukllata, sutin hina utaq tiyanan hina, huk port-wan chay port-llata saqinapaq. Ch'usaq: mana mayqinpas. Kamachiqkunallam kay sutichasqata tikrayta atinku.
account-webhook-desc: Huk tiyana, mayman WeKan willan pipas yaykuptin utaq musuq yupay ruwakuptin. Manam imapas kachakunchu uraypi huk ruwakuy markasqa kanankama. Ruwakuyta, llamkaqpa sutinta, pachatapas apan; aswan chiqankunata markay chaskiq munaptinlla.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: ¿Hayk'a p'unchawmanta aswan ñawpaq ruraykunap llapan suyasqan willakuyninkunata chinkachinki?
vcs-synced-issue: Kay sasachakuyqa tupachisqam: qatipanampi kichay, wichqaypas.
sync-write-back: Tikrasqakunata GitLabman kutichispa qillqay: uma suti, willakuy, rimasqakuna, wichqay kaqmanta kichaypas
email-bounces-description: Imatataq WeKan ruran kutimuq correokunawan: pantasqa qillqasqa tiyana, hunt'asqa casilla, mana kanimanta kutichiy, spam nisqamanta willakuy. Sapa laya kikin ruranakunayuq, chay chhika kutita kutimuptinmi ruwakun.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Tiyanaqa manam kanchu: pantasqa qillqa, qullusqa yupana, mana riqsisqa dominio.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Kunanqa manaraq chayachisqa: casilla hunt'asqa, servidor llamk'achkan. Achka qatiqllam imatapas niyta munan.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Mana oficinapi, samay pacha utaq ticket sistemamanta kutichiykuna. Correoqa chayachisqam karqan.
email-bounces-ses-description: Amazon SES nisqapi, Bounce hinallataq Complaint willakuykunata, WeKan kachasqan tiyanapaq chaskiy kamachiytapas, huk SNS temaman kachay, hinaspa kay tiyanata HTTPS nisqawan chayman qillqachiy:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Chaskinapaq SNS tema ARNkuna, sapa siqipi huk
email-bounces-clear-hint: Kay tiyanapa kutimuyninkunata qunqay, hinaspa yapamanta correota kachay
email-bounces-providers-description: Sichus WeKan kay yanapakuykunamanta hukninwan apachin chayqa, hap'ichiy, yanapakuyman kay webhook tiyanata quy kutimuq correokunapaq spam willakuykunapaqpas, kaypitaq k'askachiy llaveta chaywan paykunata silq'un, utaq pakasqa rimayta tiyanaman https://user:password@… utaq ?secret=… hina churasqaykita
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Hap'ichisqa yanapakuyqa silq'unan llaventa utaq pakasqa rimaynintam munan.
activity-pub-enabled: Llapapaq pirqakunaqa kartankunapa ruranankunata fediverse nisqapi willanku (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Ñawpaqmantaqa wañusqam. Kawsachiptiykiqa, sapa llapapaq pirqatam Mastodon nisqamanta hinaspa huk fediverse sirwiqkunamanta @board-<id> hina kay WeKanpa tiyananpi qatipayta atikun, musuq karta ruranakunapas qatipaqninkunaman chayan. Ñawinchanallapaqmi: fediverse sirwiqpa kachasqanqa manam ima pirqatapas tikranchu, sapallanpaq pirqakunaqa manam haykappas willakunchu.
caldav-sync-desc: Kay pirqapa kartankunapa tukuy pachankunata huk watanqillqaman churay - Nextcloud Calendar utaq mayqan CalDAV watanqillqapas. Watanqillqapi kuyuchisqa tukuy pachaqa kartaman kutimun. Huk app pakasqa rimayta llamk'achiy, manam qampa kikiykitachu.
caldav-invalid-url: Watanqillqapa tiyananqa http:// utaq https:// tiyananmi kanan, mana ruraqpa sutinwan nitaq pakasqa rimaywan.
caldav-not-linked: Ñawpaqta huk watanqillqa tiyananta waqaychay, kuskachaytataq kawsachiy.
webdav-storage-description: Watasqakunata huk WebDAV sirwiqpi huk q'epipi waqaychay - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud utaq mayqan hukpas. WeKanpaq ruwasqa app pakasqa rimayta llamk'achiy. WeKanpa kikin llikanpi kaq sirwiqtam kaypi llamk'achiyta atikun, kay tiyanatataq sitio kamachiqllam churan.
sqrl-desc: Ñawpaqmantaqa wañusqa. Kawsachiptiyki, yaykuna raphi SQRL-ta qun, ayllumasikunataq ñawpaqta SQRL kikinkuta Ayllumasi allichaykunapi yapanku. SQRL-qa WeKan-ta https:// tiyaypi munan.
sqrl-scan: Chiqtaqa SQRL app-ykiwan qhawachiy, utaq kay antapi SQRL llamk'anaykita kichay.
sqrl-expired: Kay SQRL chiqtaqa pachanmi tukurqan. Musuqmanta qallariy.
sqrl-description: Pakasqa rimaypa rantinpi SQRL kikiykiwan yaykuy. Kaypi huk kutita SQRL llamk'anaykiwan yapay; kaypi ima pachapas qichuyta atinki.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kay cuentapaq SQRL-wan yaykuyqa SQRL llamk'anaykimanta wañuchisqa. Chaypi qispichiy chiqtaykiwan wakmanta kawsachiy.
sqrl-only-on: SQRL llamk'anaykiqa kay cuentata SQRL-llapaq wichq'arqan: yaykunapaq huk ñankunaqa llapanmi mana chaskisqachu.
sqrl-hardlock-on: SQRL llamk'anaykiqa kay cuentata sinchita wichq'arqan: pakasqa rimayta musuqchayqa elektroniku chaskita tikrayqa mana chaskisqachu.
sqrl-hardlock: Kay cuentaqa SQRL-man wichq'asqa: manam huk ñanwanqa kutichiyta nitaq tikrayta atikunchu.
windows-sso-failed: Windows-wan yaykuyqa mana atikurqanchu. Windows cuentaykiqa manachá kaypi saqisqachu.
